title: Great Big Beautiful Life
author: Emily Henry
summary: Two writers are asked to tell the story of an elderly woman with a famous name, but only one of them will get the book. They spend time together while working to win her trust.
readIf: you like warm, witty contemporary romance with a bittersweet streak.
skipIf: you want a very fast romance or a book with spice, as this one focuses on character and emotion.

pairings.reason: Another Emily Henry story where two ambitious people in publishing circle each other.
Also about two writers at odds who are forced to share a project and slowly open up.
A glamorous older woman tells her life story to a younger writer in a more dramatic, sweeping novel.
